summary: Harte Hanks, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a merger agreement with Star Equity Holdings, Inc. Under the agreement, Merger Sub R, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Star, will merge into Harte Hanks, which will survive as a Star subsidiary. Each outstanding share of Harte Hanks common stock (excluding treasury and Star-held shares) will be converted into either $5.00 cash, 0.50 shares of Star's 10% Series A Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, or a combination, subject to shareholder elections and proration. The transaction implies a cash value of $5.00 per share. The board's recommendation and financial advisors are not specified in this excerpt. Watch for shareholder vote, regulatory approvals, and any competing bids; the premium over the prior market price and proration mechanics are key risk-arb factors.
